review.schema.interpret.run_id: Run whose complete original report was read.
review.schema.interpret.report_hash: Lowercase SHA-256 of the exact original report.md bytes.
review.schema.interpret.author: Identity of the receiving agent responsible for this interpretation.
review.schema.interpret.basis: Explain the reading and any normalization; for zero findings, explain why the quoted original explicitly establishes no findings in either section.
review.schema.interpret.complete: Attest that the complete report was read and every finding in both sections was included; not a machine proof of completeness.
review.schema.interpret.findings: Structured interpretation of all report findings.
review.schema.interpret.locations: Exactly one original line range and quote per finding; empty for zero findings.
review.schema.interpret.locations.item.f: ID of the finding supported by this quote.
review.schema.interpret.locations.item.s: One-based inclusive original report line number; CRLF is normalized to LF for quotes only.
review.schema.interpret.locations.item.e: Inclusive ending line in the original report.
review.schema.interpret.locations.item.q: Exact text of the cited complete original lines, without rewriting.
review.schema.interpret.no_findings: Required only when both arrays are empty: quote an explicit original no-findings conclusion; a parsing failure or silence is not evidence.
review.schema.interpret.no_findings.star: One-based inclusive first line of the explicit no-findings evidence.
review.schema.interpret.no_findings.end_: Inclusive last line of the explicit no-findings evidence.
review.schema.interpret.no_findings.quot: Exact original lines establishing zero findings; the author is accountable for their meaning.
review.schema.interpret.recorded_at: Tool-owned publication timestamp; omit in requests.
review.schema.interpret.findings.FINDING: Required array; use [] when this section has no findings.
Severity tier matching the enclosing section.
Complete finding text preserving the reviewer meaning.
Original source locations and reasoning supporting the finding.
Optional mechanical must-fix category; never label logic fixes mechanical.
Required for a carried item: exact immediate predecessor reference.
Existing finding ID in that predecessor.
review.schema.interpret.findings.NON_BLO: Required array; use [] when this section has no findings.
Severity tier matching the enclosing section.
Complete finding text preserving the reviewer meaning.
Original source locations and reasoning supporting the finding.
Optional mechanical must-fix category; never label logic fixes mechanical.
Required for a carried item: exact immediate predecessor reference.
Existing finding ID in that predecessor.
review.interpretation_pending: Review {{.V0}} executed successfully; report interpretation is pending. Read the complete original and submit kander review interpret before assignment or closure.
